QMines (ASX:QML) reported that a drill test known as the Pontoon Hole beneath the Mt Chalmers pit returned intersecting mineralisation over 46.8 m. The assay results indicate an average grade of 2.29 % copper and 1.03 g/t gold across the measured interval. These findings suggest a potentially strong copper‑gold resource at depth within the Mt Chalmers exploration target.
